title: Administrator (Financial Services)
description:
Morgan McKinley is looking for an experienced Administrator to work for a Financial Services type company based in the Horsham, West Sussex area. This is an admin support job opportunity, ideal for someone who has worked in a similar admin, customer services role.

Salary: 26-28 K

Location: Office based - Horsham, West Sussex. Own transport required due to the location. Parking onsite.

Hours: Monday - Thursday 8.30am-5.30pm and Friday 8:30am to 4pm

Admin support duties:
- Answering the phones, handling enquiries
- Monitoring and responding to emails
- Updating the CRM and portals
- Providing administration support to the financial services team
- Support with customer compliance documents

Skills and experience required:
- Proven Admin support experience, working in a similar role within the FS / Insurance / Pensions sector
- Excellent communication skills both verbally and written
- Good IT skills

title: Mortgage Administrator
description:
Mortgage Administrator - Horsham

£28,000 - £35,000 + benefits

Full-time

Are you an experienced Mortgage Administrator looking for your next opportunity?

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment, working closely with advisers and helping customers navigate the mortgage process from application through to completion?

We're recruiting for a Mortgage Administrator to join our successful Mortgage & Protection team in Horsham.

What you'll be doing

You'll play a key role in keeping mortgage cases moving, providing excellent service to clients and supporting the sales team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Submitting and progressing mortgage applications through to legal completion and beyond.
- Chasing outstanding documentation and ensuring applications are fully compliant.
- Liaising with solicitors regarding exchange and completion dates.
- Managing client emails and supporting repeat clients.
- Acting as the first point of contact for clients, lenders and conveyancers.
- Keeping systems and client files accurate and up to date.
- Working closely with advisers to ensure compliance and regulatory requirements are met.
- Taking ownership of customer queries and seeing them through to a successful conclusion.

What they are looking for

They're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in mortgage administration - ideally with at least 1 year's experience.
- Highly organised, accurate and methodical.
- Confident communicating with clients, lenders and other professionals.
- Customer-focused with a genuine desire to provide excellent service.
- Self-motivated and professional.
- Comfortable working under pressure and managing multiple cases.
- A team player with a high level of integrity.

What's on offer?

£28,000 - £35,000 salary, depending on experience and knowledge

Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm

23 days' holiday + bank holidays, increasing annually to 25 days

Company pension scheme

Parking available nearby

Horsham office

Ready for your next move?

If you have mortgage administration experience and want to join a successful Mortgage & Protection team where customer service, accuracy and ownership really matter, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more.

title: Purchasing Assistant
description:
Purchasing Assistant

Horsham Circa £32,000 Permanent Full-time Monday to Friday

Are you a proactive and organised individual with a flair for negotiation, building relationships and keeping things running smoothly?

Do you enjoy a varied role where you can take ownership, solve problems and make a genuine difference to the day-to-day operations of a business?

We are delighted to be recruiting for an established and successful business in Horsham, who are looking to welcome a Purchasing Assistant to their team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain or a similar administrative role who is looking to develop their skills and build a long-term career.

What will you be doing?
- Managing purchase orders from initial enquiry through to delivery.
- Building and maintaining strong working relationships with suppliers.
- Negotiating competitive prices and delivery times.
- Monitoring outstanding orders and proactively resolving any delays.
- Reviewing stock requirements and ensuring materials are available to meet business demands.
- Sourcing and researching potential new suppliers.
- Resolving supplier queries and discrepancies.
- Working closely with internal departments to ensure the smooth running of daily operations.
- Maintaining accurate purchasing records and updating internal systems.

What are we looking for?
- Previous experience within purchasing, procurement, supply chain or a manufacturing administration environment would be advantageous.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- A confident communicator who enjoys building relationships.
- A proactive approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong problem-solving skills and commercial awareness.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and experience using business management systems.
- An aptitude for understanding technical information and a willingness to learn.

You don't necessarily need to have held the job title of Purchasing Assistant before. If you have relevant transferable experience, a positive attitude and a genuine desire to develop within purchasing, we would love to hear from you.

What's in it for you?
- Salary circa £32,000, depending on experience.
- Permanent, full-time employment.
- Monday to Friday working.
- Company pension scheme.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
- The opportunity to join an established and stable business.

If you are looking for a varied and rewarding opportunity where your organisational skills, initiative and ability to build relationships will be genuinely valued, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential discussion with Harris Lord Recruitment.

Harris Lord is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Sales & Quotation Support Administrator
description:
Morgan McKinley is looking for an experienced Sales & Quotation Support Administrator to work for a great company based in the Horsham, West Sussex area. The Sales Administrator will support the Estimating team by monitoring and responding to customer sales enquiries, prioritising quotations, following up on the sales leads, updating the CRM and passing leads to the relevant teams.

Salary: up to 32 K dependent on experience

Location: Office based - outskirts of Horsham, West Sussex. Own transport required due to location

Sales & Quotation Admin Support duties:
- Ensure all enquiries are entered into the CRM system
- Proactively follow up on any new sales leads, such as customer enquiries that come in
- Liaise with new and existing clients
- Process any customer quotation amendments
- Identify, contact and qualify all quotation enquiries and pass them to the relevant sales contact
- Create new accounts on the system
- Monitor and respond to email / phone enquiries

Skills & Experience:
- Experience of working in a similar sales support, quotations estimations, admin role within the Construction, Engineering or Manufacturing sector
- Excellent communication and customer services skills
- Good IT and CRM skills such as Hubspot
